messages:
Maya K: Quick heads-up — I'm pulling together a short competitor-contrast script for next week's launch posts and the webinar. Need razor‑sharp lines vs cloud AI platforms, LLM APIs, and infra vendors. low-friction bullets pls.
Noah R: Start with economics + predictability. one-liner: 'Predictable per-request economics vs surprise bills' or 'Committed throughput beats burst pricing for steady workloads'. keep it customer-centric. :white_check_mark:
Samir: Two headline directions: 1) product-first: 'Same API, predictable cost' 2) infra-first: 'Latency and SLAs that scale'
Ellie P: Webinar idea: demo a 30-min load run showing 99th pct latency + cost per 1M tokens. then 10-min Q&A on quantization/rollouts. makes it tangible. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Cory L: Bench framing note: call out metrics we can defend — median and 99th latency, tokens/sec, and cost per 1k tokens. avoid raw model names in marketing claims. also include a small footnote on dataset & workload.
Maya K: Love the demo framing. Can someone draft two 1-line soundbites we can A/B test in landing and tweet? fast.
Samir: Drafts: A) 'Ship features, not bill shock — predictable inference economics for product teams.' B) 'Deployable everywhere: same API, consistent latency across hosted, dedicated, and private clouds.'
Noah R: Quick edit: swap 'bill shock' to 'surprise bills' for a softer tone. so A becomes: 'Ship features, not surprise bills — predictable inference economics for product teams.'
Ellie P: For speakers, suggest product + eng (runtime lead) so we can answer kernel/quantization Qs live. also run a 2-slide appendix with config snippets (batching, cache) we can drop in chat.
Martech Bot: auto-upload: https://redwood-internal/briefs/launch-bench-template (internal)
Cory L: Also include a short rebut list vs infra vendors: 1) "we manage model routing & rollouts" 2) "unit-cost controls (batching/caching)" 3) "observability per-route" — 1-liners only.
Maya K: Perfect. Action items: Samir finalize 2 soundbites + 3 short rebut lines, Cory add bench footnote and defended metrics, Ellie finalize webinar runbook, Noah to approve tone. I'll wire a one-pager for sales. Target: EOD tomorrow. :rocket:
Noah R: ACK. I'll review after lunch. :eyes:
